scope: Actual defined rational kernels on all shifted dyadic grids. No coefficientwise chart-content, weighted mode count, degree/recovery, recursion, ECDLP or novelty theorem.
statement: For every natural a, valid k<2^(a+1) and rational t where the actual baseKernel is nonzero, the actual squareKernel has rational2-adic valuation twice that of the baseKernel, with its unit normalizer derived.
